chapter.verse: Phattuampih ding bangmah om lo himah taleh kong kisialsuak ding a, Topa' hong piak muhtuamte leh mangmuhnate kong genzom ding hi.
Tuma kum sawmleli lai-in Khris sunga mi khat (a pumpi tawh hiam, a pumpi lo tawh hiam ka thei kei a, Pasian' theih hi-in) vantung thumna ah a kilaktoh ka thei hi.
Ka theihpih lai thu ah hih mipa pen (a pumpi tawh hiam, a pumpi lo tawh hiam ka thei kei a, Pasian' theih hi-in)
Paradise ah kilato a, mihing' kam tawh genkhiatkik theihloh zahin a siangtho thute za hi.
Tua bang mi khat' hangin kei kong kisial ding a, ahi zongin keilekei' thu-in ahihleh ka thanemna thute longal kong kisial kei ding hi.

A hang pen ka kisialhnop phial leh zong thumaan thutak a gen ding ka hih manin a haivai ka hi tuankei ding hi. Ahi zongin kuamah in kei' sunga a muh thute leh kei' kiangpana a zak thute zah khengvalin hong pi-ngaihsutkhak loh nadingin kisial lo dingin ka kidaam hi.

Tua banah a thupitna tehtheih loh ahi mangmuhnate hangin ka kisaktheih luatkhak loh ding deihna-in kei hong nawngkaisak dingin Satan' kamtai, pumsun ling khat hong kipia a, tua pen ka kisaktheih luatkhak loh nading ahi hi.
Hih ling hong lakkhiatsak nadingin Topa' kiangah thumvei pulakin ka thum hi.

Ahih hangin Topa in, “Keima' hehpihna nang' ading kicing hi. Keima' vangliatna pen thanemna sungah cingtaak thadim hi,” hong ci hi. Tua hangin Khris' vangliatna kei' tung hong tun theih nadingin ka thanemnate lungdamtak ka kisialhpih semsem lai ding hi.
Tua hi a, Khris' ading ahih nakleh thanemna, simmawhna, dongtuahna, bawlsiatna leh haksatna cihte tawh ka lungkim hi. A hang pen ka thanem hun simin a thadim ka hi hi.

Mihai ka suak khinzo hi. Note' phat dingin a kilawm khinsa ka hih manin tua mun ah hong thatang tun na hi uh hi. A hang pen bangmah ka mat loh hangin tua sawltak-mangpite sangin ka niamzaw peuhmah kei hi.
A taktakin sawltak taktak khentelna limte ahi, lungduaina a khungdawn ahi zongin, kihilna lim lamdangte leh nalamdangte ahi zongin note' lakah hong kilak khin hi.
Tua ahihleh vangik kong suat loh vai longal pawlpi dangte sangin kong neubawlzawkna bang om ahi hiam? Hih ka khialhna hong maisak un!

En dih un, note' kiangah a thumveina hong pai dingin a kigingsa ka hi hi. Kei' zon pen note' neihsa hilo-in nomaumah na hih manun note' ading vangik kong hikei ding hi. A hang pen tate in nute pate' ading sum khol ding vaipuak nei lo-in nute pate in tate' ading a khol ding uh hizaw hi.
Na nunna kha uh' adingin lungdamtak ka piakhia ding a, zong a bupin ka kipiakhia ding hi. Note hong itbeh semsem le-ing kei hong kitawm-it semsem ding dan hi mai ahi hiam?
Ahi zongin note vangik kong suat loh a maan hinapi, kei pen khuakzat a siam, khemna tawh note hong metbawl, nong ci uh hi.
Note' kiangah kong sawlkhiatte khatpeuh tungtawnin note hong khembawl ka hi hiam?
Hong pai dingin Titus ka hanthawn a, amah tawh sanggampa kong tonsak hi. Titus in note hong khembawl ahi hiam? Lungsim kikhatin a gamta hilo ka hi uh hiam? Zawi kibang a tawnkhawm hilo ka hi uh hiam?
Note' kiangah koleko a kiphelhphelh danin hong ngaihsun thapai na hi uh hiam? Kong itte aw, Pasian' mai-ah Khris' min tawh thu a gengen ka hi uh a, tuate khempeuh note' kilambeh nading ahi hi.

A hang pen kong tun ciangin kei' deihdan namin note kong muh lohkhak ding, ahihkeileh note' deihdan namin kei nong muh lohkhak ding uh ka patau hi. Kitotna, kidemnopna, lungsona, angsung theihna, gendaina, gensiatna, khemna, kihihsakna, thulela kitukkalhna, cihte peuh a omkhak ding ka patau hi.

Kong tunkik ciangin ka Pasian in note' mai-ah kei hong niamkhiatkhak ding cih ahi zongin, tuma-a mawhna bawlte tua a bawl uh thanghuai gamtatna, nulepa tatkhialhna, cilesa paktatna cihte pan a kisik loh uh huhau-in lungnuam lo-in ka omkhak ding ahi zongin, ka patau hi.
